key_insight: Rank-4 W4A4 post-training quantization can be made much more accurate by jointly optimizing a low-rank compensation branch and quantized residuals, using a deflated Hessian plus an activation-noise surrogate.
engineering_relevance: This offers a practical path to deploy diffusion transformers and LLMs at 4-bit precision with lower memory, faster quantization, and less accuracy loss.
method: Model weight quantization as a coupled calibration problem for the low-rank branch and residual branch.
Derive a deflated Hessian by removing errors already explained by the low-rank factor.
Add an activation-noise surrogate to explicitly reduce 4-bit activation quantization error.
evidence_signal: Across five diffusion backbones, rank-4 method outperforms rank-4 SVDQuant on PSNR and LPIPS, and on several models it even beats rank-32 SVDQuant with up to 8x smaller rank and 6.25x faster quantization; on Qwen3-8B it raises MMLU from 61.50% to 68.17%.
watch_item: The approach still depends on careful calibration and low-rank fitting quality, so performance may be sensitive to model architecture, activation statistics, and implementation of the second-order approximation.
paper_title: Deflating the Hessian: Rank-4 W4A4 Quantization for Multimodal Diffusion Transformers
